description: This Java source file defines the 'PreferenceWorker' class, which contains utility methods for managing user preferences within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for permission checks, preference conversions, and utility functions related to user preference handling.

classes.name: PreferenceWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling user preferences, permission checks, and conversions in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addPrefToMap
methods.description: Adds a user preference record to a preference map, converting its value based on its data type.

methods.name: checkCopyPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to copy preferences, with special handling for admin permissions.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to get/set preferences based on the main action.

methods.name: createUserPrefMap
methods.description: Converts a GenericValue or list of GenericValues into a user preference map.

methods.name: getUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the userLoginId parameter from the context, defaulting to a predefined value if not found.

methods.name: isValidGetId
methods.description: Determines if a user can retrieve preferences for the specified userLoginId.

methods.name: isValidSetId
methods.description: Determines if the current user can set preferences for the specified userLoginId.

methods.name: toFieldMap
methods.description: Creates a map of fields suitable for creating or updating a GenericValue representing user preferences.
